en.headline: Seasonal flu programme reaches 700000 doses as Lo urges higher uptake
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said the current seasonal influenza vaccination programme has administered about 700,000 doses in less than a month and expressed hope the rate would exceed last year's figure.
body: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said the 2026-27 seasonal influenza vaccination programme, which began on 17 September, had delivered about 700,000 doses in less than a month. He hoped the overall uptake would surpass the roughly 2.03 million doses administered in the previous season.

Lo noted that this year's plan includes several enhancements, such as a more diversified procurement of vaccines, an increase in the pilot scheme for private doctors from 100,000 to 300,000 doses, electronic consent forms, and stronger community outreach. About 99 per cent of schools, more than 2,200, are participating in outreach services for students.

He urged people living with elderly family members, or those working in residential care homes or hospitals, to get vaccinated promptly to protect themselves and those around them. Legislative Council President Starry Lee said more than 40 lawmakers received the vaccine at an event on Wednesday and called on the public to get protected early as the new flu season approaches.

zh.headline: 流感疫苗計劃至今接種70萬劑 盧寵茂冀接種率超去年
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，本年度流感疫苗接種計劃自上月17日開始至今未滿一個月已接種約70萬劑，希望整體接種率可超越去年約203萬劑。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，2026至27年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃自上月17日展開，至今未夠一個月已接種約70萬劑。他希望整體接種率可以進一步提高，超越上一季約203萬劑的數字。
盧寵茂指今年計劃有多項優化，包括採購更多元疫苗、私家醫生先導計劃由10萬劑增至30萬劑、推出電子同意書，以及加強社區推動。約99%學校、即超過2200間已參與外展服務為學童接種。
他呼籲家中有長者、或在院舍及醫院工作照顧長者或病人的市民盡快接種，以保護自己及身邊的人。立法會主席李慧琼表示，周三的活動有超過40名議員接種疫苗，並呼籲市民及早接種預防新一季流感。
